Bypasses cliff tower stun immunity and stun immunity from the [[Medic]]'s shield. |ability1_cooldown = 8 }} ==Description== The '''Security''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had a decently high health and a decent amount of [[Defense]], though it walked rather slowly. It has one ability, which uses to stun towers for 4 seconds and deal 5,000 damage to units. This bypasses cliff tower stun immunity and the [[Medic]]'s shield stun immunity. It will target any tower or unit in its range of 28 that is also not in its minimal range of 10. ==Logbook Description== "''Security watches all corners of the theater and ensures all guests are safe from (Outside) danger. With cameras for heads, they will catch anyone in 4K if they're doing something wrong. They patrol silently through hallways and backstage areas - always watching, always listening.''" ==Appearance== The '''Security''' has black shoes and pants with small yellow stripping running up and down. A grey vest with yellow buttons and a black tie with a white under-shirt. On top it wears a red jacket that is open in the front with yellow trimming and yellow buttons. Is has white gloves on its hands and a yellow band on its left forearm. Instead of a head it has a camera with a grey body and yellow lens along with four red dots with one being in each corner. It also wears a red military esc beret with a yellow bottom sitting on the left side of its camera. On the outside of its right leg it has a taser which has a grey body and yellow outside. It also walks with its arms behind its back while its camera slowly moves left and right. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Mercenary Base]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Warlock]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended against this. **Cliff towers cannot be used to avoid its stun, as it bypasses cliff tower stun immunity. Towers like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Brawler]] can still be used however, as they will not be targeted. **Towers like the [[DJ Booth]] or [[Commander]] can be used to boost their statistics. *The [[Medic]] cannot be used to shield towers from its stun as the '''Security''' bypasses its shield. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SecurityWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) SecurityTaser.gif|''Surveillance Shot'' animation (20 December 2025 – Present) SecurityDeath.gif|Death animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCameraman.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SecurityIconIG.png|'''Security''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Security''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Security''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Security''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Stereo Man]]|Wave 20|Security|Wave 21|[[Extra D]]|Wave 22}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
